classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q7: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The denominator x(x−1) excludes the resulting candidate 1; this essential check is absent from the teaching example and retained by editorial decision.

answer.short:
No solution.

Clearing the denominators gives $x=1$, which makes an original denominator zero.
answer.worked:
The original denominators require $x\ne0,1$.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x+1-2x}{x(x-1)}&=\frac{3(x-1)}{x(x-1)}\\x+1-2x&=3(x-1)\\1-x&=3x-3\\4&=4x\\x&=1\end{align*}$$

Since $x=1$ is excluded, there is no solution.
